messages:
rachel: Reopening follow-ups from the GPU postmortem to lock owners, ETAs, and a short recurrence-watch plan. I want one-line owners here so we can push to tickets.

marta: I'll own the temporary quota request + billing loop. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC. Need the latest 1m peak for the ticket.

jordan: I'll own scheduler tuning + canary. Plan: +12% max_pending broadly, reduce batch_window_ms to 30 on latency routes, canary on gpu-canary-5 for 30m. ETA Tue COB.

tess: I'll update the surge runbook with exact mitigation commands and a rollback checklist. Will include runnable snippets and contact matrix. ETA Wed AM.

rachel: Telemetry owner? We need a 1m rolling headroom metric, model-level QPS, and an alert rule for headroom <10% sustained 3m that pages oncall.

ops-bot: I can create metrics/alerts. I'll add metric names `gpu.headroom.1m` and `model.qps.1m`, and an AlertRule to page on sustained headroom <10% for 3m. Filing ticket INFRA-950 for telemetry.

rachel: Action register (compact):
- QUOTA: temp soft quota + billing signoff (owner: marta)
- SCHEDULER: tuning + canary + smoke test (owner: jordan)
- RUNBOOK: surge playbook + rollback checklist (owner: tess)
- TELEMETRY: 1m headroom + model QPS + paging alert (owner: ops-bot)
- GUARDRAIL: autoscaler min_free_gpus policy (owner: rachel)

marta: For the quota ticket use this justification: "Repeated short bursts exceeded reserved GPU pools causing scheduling backpressure; requesting temporary quota to restore 20% headroom while autoscaler and scheduler changes are validated."

devops-bot: Created tasks INFRA-950 (telemetry), INFRA-951 (quota), INFRA-952 (scheduler-canary), INFRA-953 (runbook). Links: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-950..953. Assigned as above.

jordan: Canary test plan: deploy config to gpu-canary-5, run replay for 30m (mix long/short loads), measure p95 latency, queue depth, and failed schedules. Rollback criteria: p95 > baseline*1.10 or failed schedules > baseline + 25. ETA Tue COB will include cost delta.

tess: Runbook PR: https://git.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge/PR-200  includes commands `rbctl scale --pool=reserved --min=20`, `rbctl enable-temp-quota --delta=32 --ttl=72h` and a rollback section. Please review. ETA Wed AM.

rachel: For guardrail I'll propose min_free_gpus = max(ceil(reserved*0.18), 8) with an oncall override that expires after 2h. I'll own the policy change and tests. ETA Mon EOD.

marta: Claiming INFRA-951. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC; will cc billing and include rachel's snapshot.

ops-bot: Recurring meeting "GPU postmortem check-ins" scheduled Wednesdays 09:30 UTC for 4 weeks. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/e/9999.

jordan: I'll attach the smoke test script to INFRA-952 and run the canary tomorrow. If smoke tests fail, I'll revert and link rollback steps.

tess: Reviewed runbook PR comments and updated escalation contact list. PR now includes test steps to validate rollback works end-to-end.

rachel: Everyone paste final ETA here so this thread is canonical. We'll escalate to oncall if any ETA slips >48h.

marta: ETA Fri 18:00 UTC.

jordan: ETA Tue COB.

tess: ETA Wed AM.

ops-bot: Telemetry ETA Thu EOD (INFRA-950).

rachel: Guardrail ETA Mon EOD.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll publish a short follow-up note linking INFRA tickets once quota is submitted. If anything blocks your work, post here and we'll escalate. :white_check_mark:
